name: NFLmon
description: Collect, train, and trade NFL players in a Pokemon-style game

commands.name: starter
commands.longDescription: Begin your NFLmon journey by selecting one of 5 random common players as your starter. This command can only be used once per user.

examples.output: Choose Your Starter NFLmon! Select from 5 common players using the numbered buttons.

tips: This is a one-time selection - choose wisely!
All starters are Common rarity
You have 60 seconds to make your choice

commands.name: nflmon bench
commands.longDescription: Browse your collection of NFLmon with pagination. Filter by rarity to find specific players.

examples.output:
Your NFLmon Bench - Total: 15 NFLmon
🌱 Patrick Mahomes (QB) Lv.5 [T]
⭐ Josh Allen (QB) Lv.23

tips: [T] indicates NFLmon in training
* indicates favorites
NFLmon are sorted by level descending

commands.name: nflmon view
commands.longDescription: View complete details for a specific NFLmon including stats, IVs, evolution progress, and XP.

examples.output:
⭐ Patrick Mahomes
KC | QB | #15
Rarity: Legendary | Level: 25

Stats:
SPD: 72 (IV: 12)
PWR: 65 (IV: 8)
...

tips: IVs range from 0-15 and are set when caught
Higher rarity = higher stat multiplier
Use the ID shown in /nflmon bench

commands.name: nflmon train
commands.description: Assign NFLmon to a training slot
commands.longDescription: Put an NFLmon in training to earn XP from activities like Wordle, Trivia, and Blackjack wins.

examples.output: Patrick Mahomes is now training in slot 1!

tips: You start with 1 training slot
Buy additional slots from /shop for 3,000 coins each
All training NFLmon receive full XP from activities

commands.name: nflmon untrain
commands.longDescription: Remove an NFLmon from its training slot, freeing the slot for another NFLmon.

examples.output: Patrick Mahomes has been removed from training.

tips: NFLmon must be untrained before trading or selling

commands.name: nflmon nickname
commands.longDescription: Give your NFLmon a custom nickname. Leave the name empty to clear the nickname.

examples.output: Patrick Mahomes is now known as Showtime!

commands.name: nflmon evolve
commands.description: Evolve your NFLmon to the next stage
commands.longDescription: When your NFLmon reaches the required level, evolve it to unlock the next evolution stage with a new emoji indicator.

examples.output: ⭐ Evolution Complete! Patrick Mahomes evolved to Pro!

tips: Hall of Famer requires Rare rarity or higher
Evolution is automatic at level thresholds but must be triggered

commands.name: nflmon sell
commands.longDescription: Sell an NFLmon from your collection for coins. Sell value is based on rarity.

examples.output:
Are you sure you want to sell Patrick Mahomes for 🪙 1,000?
[Confirm Sell] [Cancel]

tips: NFLmon in training cannot be sold
Favorite NFLmon cannot be sold (safety feature)
Sale is permanent - there is no buyback

commands.name: nflmon stats
commands.longDescription: View your overall NFLmon collection statistics including total caught, legendaries, evolutions, and training slots.

examples.output:
Your NFLmon Stats
Total Caught: 25
Legendaries: 2
Evolutions: 8
Highest Level: 45
Training Slots: 2/3

commands.name: nflmon leaderboard
commands.longDescription: See the top NFLmon collectors across different categories.

examples.output:
NFLmon Leaderboard: Most Legendaries
1. Player1 - 5
2. Player2 - 3
...

commands.name: nflmon dex
commands.longDescription: View all available NFLmon players with search and filter options.

options.name: search
options.description: Search by name, position:WR, or team:KC

examples.output:
NFLmon Dex - Showing 5 of 5 players
🌟 Patrick Mahomes - KC | QB | #15
🌟 Josh Allen - BUF | QB | #17
...

tips: Use position:XX to filter by position
Use team:XX to filter by team
Combine with rarity filter for precise searches

commands.name: nflmon trade offer
commands.longDescription: Propose a trade with another user. You can offer an NFLmon and optionally request one of theirs or include coins.
usage: /nflmon trade offer user:@player my_nflmon:42 their_nflmon:55 coins:500

options.name: coins
options.description: Coins to include with your offer

examples.output: Trade Offer Sent! The other user will receive a DM to accept or reject.

tips: Trades expire after 24 hours
NFLmon in training cannot be traded
The recipient receives a DM with accept/reject buttons

commands.name: nflmon trade pending
commands.longDescription: See all pending trade offers you've sent or received.

examples.output:
Your Pending Trades
📥 INCOMING - Trade #15 with @player (expires in 20h)
📤 OUTGOING - Trade #14 with @friend (expires in 5h)

commands.name: nflmon trade cancel
commands.longDescription: Cancel a pending trade offer that you initiated.
tips: You can only cancel trades you sent
Use /nflmon trade pending to find trade IDs
